gate_0a: PASSED. A client BindToRenderStep at RenderPriority.Character + 1 that writes Bone.Transform on LeftArm, RightArm and Head changes the rendered pose while the replicated server Animator plays its clip (seen in two screenshots, override off / on). At that render step bone.Transform read back holds the Animator's own pose (non-identity, replaced every frame: 60 of 60 reads), so 'animator = bone.Transform; bone.Transform = animator:Lerp(target, w)' works as the brief's player design assumes.
